items.title: Onaje Allan Gumbs interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2001
items.q: I remember when I was three years old I would walk around the room singing “Oh My Papa,” by Eddie Fisher.

ctx.x: She swears I was doing like this when I was a baby in the crib, just going like this, so she realized I had some musical talent. And I remember when I was three years old, this I remember, when I was three years old I would walk around the room singing “Oh My Papa,” by Eddie Fisher.
